Modelica.Electrical.Digital.Examples.Cou.detail: reference_failure: The default OMC reference (stopTime=100, 500 output intervals) reports a state event at t=0.4 on all eight integer(delay(xr, delayTime)) crossings of the flip-flop transport delays, although every delay source has been constant since t=0.001 and the next input change is the clock edge at t=0.5. From that event every flip-flop output is 'X' to the end. The OMC result depends on the output grid, not on the model: the same OMC executable with stopTime=10, 20, or 50, or with stopTime=100 and 1000 or 5000 output intervals, counts exactly as Counter3 and as this counter with n=3 do. The Rumoca trace agrees with the 1000- and 5000-interval OMC runs on every shared channel. This is a reference-generation failure, not strict-high credit.
